definition.def: Administration is the range of activities connected with organizing and supervising the way that an organization or institution functions.
examples: Too much time is spent on administration.

definition.def: The administration of something is the process of organizing and supervising it.
examples: Standards in the administration of justice have degenerated. [+ of]
The cost of administration is around £500.

definition.def: The administration of a company or institution is the group of people who organize and supervise it.
examples: ... a member of the college administration.

definition.def: You can refer to a country's government as the administration; used especially in the United States.
examples: He declined to appoint Ashley to a senior post in the administration.
He urged the administration to come up with a plan to reduce the budget deficit.
